The most likely DOI is 10.1515/lity.2008.007, since the "lity" prefix belongs to *Linguistic Typology* and fits a title about uncovering universals. My earlier suggestion of 10.1515/THLI.2008.007 was wrong: that DOI belongs to Croft & Poole's *Theoretical Linguistics* article, which has a different title. I could not confirm either candidate at doi.org or from a search record, so please check the DOI there before citing it.

CONFIDENCE: 55
